name: HaloShop_Juice
note: Shop (24 x 15 x 18). Rect body 20 x 13, ground storey 9.5 with a wide rect stall opening each side of the centred door (the 2D has ONE stall opening right of an off-centre door at the far left: generator door is always centred, so the shopfront is mirrored), short upper tier with two small arched windows beside the sign, gold corner pilasters, wide yellow/cream awning, two corner planters with topiary, flat roof with a marble balustrade. No lantern pedestals (the stall windows take that wall). Missing: gold sign plaque, off-centre door, stall counter + juice jars + fruit crates, rooftop parasol pavilion (4 gold posts + blue/white canopy + fruit crates), ivy, lanterns without pedestals (see generator_gaps.md). Built from art/review/img3/HaloShop_Juice_check.jpg (2D panel); the 2D PNG is not in the worktree.
